claim: G31 P2: exact version-matched official Mattermost source can establish whether create-post supplies a destination-side identity, deduplication, or result-lookup mechanism sufficient for safe recovery from an accepted-but-response-lost outcome, without assuming the G30 mock capability exists live.
non_claims: No local Mattermost contact, credential lookup/use, message read/send, candidate revision, live transport implementation, bridge activation, promotion, Docker mutation, model call, live grant, G31 canary result, production readiness, or universal Mattermost/version guarantee.
rationale: G30 proved same-key recovery only in a mock that implemented destination deduplication. The pinned create-post OpenAPI requires channel_id and message but does not state idempotency. S-904 and C-066 forbid carrying an unconditional exactly-once claim across an incapable or unverified destination.
reading: Retain both controls and the full ledger. Reread G30 closure limitations, G31 P0/P1 outcomes, exact candidate effect descriptor, pinned Mattermost OpenAPI reference, C-020-C-024/C-064-C-066/C-095-C-103, S-502-S-504/S-903-S-905/S-1001/S-1003-S-1005/S-1101-S-1105. Acquire only official Mattermost source/docs corresponding to the observed 11.7.7 image and pin every URL/ref/hash.
representation: Represent each relevant server mechanism with version/ref, exact source span/hash, request-supplied identity, server persistence relation, duplicate behavior, result-lookup path, uncertainty, and applicability to the candidate descriptor. Absence from one document is not proof of impossibility; code-path evidence may support or defeat the mechanism. Unresolved remains distinct from unsupported.
consumer: PeTTa/MeTTa compares source-grounded mechanism relations and returns supported, qualified, unsupported, or unresolved reconciliation standing. Builder scripts may fetch and extract read-only official public source as evidence. No LLM or Prolog/live service interprets the effect guarantee or chooses candidate revision.
falsifiers: A current or mismatched version substitutes for 11.7.7; search snippets or model prose substitute for source; undocumented header/key is assumed; candidate descriptor lacks the mechanism but is called sufficient; missing response is called failure/success; local service/credential/message is touched; or unsupported/unresolved is rewritten as exactly-once.
scope_review: Read-only retrieval of the minimum official Mattermost 11.7.7/tag-matched API and server code needed to trace create-post identity, pending_post_id/props behavior, duplicate handling and result lookup; hash raw files; native comparison and negative controls; evidence and next plan. No local Mattermost HTTP/WebSocket, credential, Docker mutation, candidate edit, transport, model, activation, promotion, push or control change.
rollback: P2 adds read-only sources, native reasoning and evidence only. Removing them restores P1; no candidate/live/promoted state changes. Failed or absent source mechanisms remain preserved as consequence for a separately frozen candidate revision plan.
